reason: I make about $13k a year, so $147 a month is more than I spend on all my other tools put together, and other Instagram DM tools cost a third of that. Most of my leads come from posting and comment-to-DM, so I only do cold outreach when the pipeline is thin, and I can't justify a monthly bill for that.
objection: $147 a month is three or four times what other DM tools charge, and there are no customer results at all. I'd also have to put in a card for a trial and forget to cancel by day 4, and then payments are final. For me that's real rent money.
would_change_my_mind: A price under about $50 a month, or a month-to-month plan with a refund, plus a few real agency owners my size showing they booked calls with it.
